verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own documentation provides a walkthrough to install and deploy Bitwarden on your own Linux server, which directly covers self-hosting the core product. The evidence is a single thin doc snippet, so depth and parity with the cloud service are not shown. Missing for 10: details on self-hosted feature parity and licensing requirements, other deployment targets beyond Linux, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: This article will walk you through the procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden to your own Linux server.
